citations.assessment: Rav Naḥman son of Rav Ḥisda transmits the practical ruling in his father's name.
The exact named son of Ḥisda asks Rav Naḥman bar Yaakov about the dispute before or after final judgment.
The named figures recur in a question about the Mishnah's ruling.
The question concerns sharecropper testimony, with Rav Yosef sitting before Rav Naḥman.
The bar Yaakov reply cites the questioner's grandfather in Rav's name.
The collector is the named son of Rav Ḥisda. Bar Yitzḥak cites Torah, Prophets and Writings.
The contrast is stated from bar Yitzḥak's perspective. His own receiving entry quotes the same passage.
This exchange concerns the covering of blood. Bar Yitzḥak says he gave the ruling to the son of Rav Ḥisda. The Shevuot exchange concerns a different ruling.
A separate controversy about the bird offering explicitly gives Rav Shimi of Nehardea as the upstream transmitter.
